# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.9 GA - Build 344
Player-First Language.
- Explains every EOC page in clear language for a capable 15-year-old reader. - Uses short steps that name the exact menu, action and repeat condition. - Makes completed-test buttons follow the displayed next action. - Replaces unsupported display separators with plain text. - Preserves normal X4 resources and existing player authority.
Runtime accepted by RazorEQX. Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
